name: templates-dir-required
body: The template library must be resolvable: kalide uses the library at the `templates:` path configured in `kalide.yaml` when present (see external-template-library) as the external layer, and the deck-root `templates/` directory as the local layer whenever that directory exists; the two merge into the deck's one template library (layered-template-library). If no layer resolves — the key is absent and there is no local `templates/` (or it is not a directory), or the configured path is missing or not a valid library — `kalide start` and `kalide templates [name]` (and the gallery) fail with a clear message naming the expected/offending path and a non-zero exit, suggesting `kalide init` for new projects when there is no local `templates/`. A configured path that is missing or invalid is an error naming that path — kalide never substitutes the local `templates/` for it — and the local `templates/` contributes to the library alongside a resolvable configured path (requirements.constraint.configured-library-authoritative).
